title: Emergence of Kastor-Traschen spacetime from a nonlinear Dirac system
summary: We establish a uniqueness theorem in four-dimensional spacetime, demonstrating that a nonlinear spinor system naturally constrains the background geometry to the Kastor-Traschen spacetime, which describes dynamical, cosmic multi-black-holes. By analyzing a nonlinear field equation where the super-covariant derivative of a Dirac spinor is sourced by intrinsic fermion currents, we evaluate its integrability under two physical requirements: a phase-locking condition enforcing a real hermitian product $\overlineψ_R ψ_L$, and a pure-electric source condition.
